text: Entry drafter system prompt as written (one short line describing work, using only the events provided).
note: The prompt is not in the repository outside the handoff.

text: At most 12 words. No period at the end.
note: No drafter or output check.

text: Name the concrete thing worked on, taken from the event titles.
note: No drafter.

text: Do not add facts, outcomes, or reasons that are not in the events.
note: No drafter.

text: Do not use words like successfully, critical, important, significant, ensured.
note: No drafter; important and ensured are not in the copy linter list either.

text: If the events are only a meeting, use the meeting title as the line.
note: No drafter.

text: If you cannot describe the work from the events, output exactly: UNCLEAR.
note: No drafter.

text: Output only the line.
note: No drafter.

text: Never state that the user is eligible, compliant, or safe.
note: The validator rejects these words and is tested; no assistant model is wired, so the rule guards nothing live.

note: You should or you must is rejected, but validate_answer passes File this form now and Submit the I-765 this week.

text: Always cite the source (USCIS, ICE SEVP, CFR, the school's ISSS page) and link it.
note: A source id is required on each sentence and the result screen shows citations; the validator does not require a link and no school source exists.

text: End every answer with one concrete next step the user can take, or ask your DSO.
note: Described as the step-back card; no code builds it and nothing checks the ending of an answer.
